horizon_rationale: Declared before outcomes: retained joint seed17 controls first reached the fixed target at200; both100 controls missed. This does not extend or reclassify the failed frozen-head100 screen.
hypothesis: Restrict original FP32 action-head plasticity to ordinary low-rank DiT attention updates while retaining language LoRA, to test whether adaptation can reach the fixed target without the observed motion-axis drift of full-head tuning.
limits: One paired development seed on the existing exposed ten-task cohort. This is a new parameterization and clipping trajectory, not an arithmetic-preserving optimization or a release claim.

memory_attribution.head_policy: Any head-gradient/moment saving belongs to BOTH precision arms. Report actual allocated and sampled owned-process peaks and missing host coverage separately. No algebraic saving is a measured peak.

no_automatic_followup: No new rank/LR sweep, seed, horizon extension, rollout, dataset change or quality-based omission; all failed correctness and learning outcomes remain retained.

parameter_policy.artifacts: Native own-source DCP and portable; standalone unmerged FP32 head base/bias plus exact factors. Merged conversion is unsupported for this profile.
parameter_policy.compute: Preserve native BF16 ambient autocast and native FP32 training state/action/noise/time math; no optimizer precision or group change.
parameter_policy.excluded: All seven category-specific projectors; FF, AdaNorm, timestep/output projectors, VL self-attention, embeddings and normalization; no head-base quantization or cast.

parameter_policy.initialization: Original language factor initialization unchanged. Independent same-seed device generator initializes FP32 head A and zero B after language initialization, without consuming global noise RNG.
parameter_policy.native_modes: Preserve original full-head tune_projector/tune_diffusion_model/tune_vlln and native training/dropout modes; train_action_head=false freezes original parameters only, without no_grad or eval wrappers.

unchanged_release_guards.adaptation_guard: The trained recipe must reach the fixed offline adaptation target and demonstrate useful action/task behavior over the original source. A noninferiority pass alone does not show adaptation.
unchanged_release_guards.closed_loop_rationale: At most one additional failed trajectory per 50 episodes. This requires actual simulator outcomes; action MSE is insufficient.
unchanged_release_guards.decision: No release qualification from this exposed development cohort. Retain every failed/unreached trial and the unchanged NF4 control before any further learning intervention.
unchanged_release_guards.improvement_objective: Report paired quality and time-to-quality improvement versus BF16 LoRA separately from preservation. Favorable means alone do not establish improvement.
unchanged_release_guards.offline_rationale: A 5% MSE budget allows at most sqrt(1.05)-1 = 2.47% relative RMSE amplitude increase. This is a prospective task-level precision budget, not a WTS NLL margin.
